Results.ReviewText: We were looking to downsize our grill since we mainly cook just for two. The Weber Q 1200 gas grill is the perfect size for us. We also got the folding grill stand and the adapter hose to connect to a regular size propane tank when using it at home. The smaller footprint and lighter weight makes it a breeze to transport, and we can easily store it in the garage between uses. Great product!
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 gas grill

Results.ReviewText: It’s small. Good for a couple or family of 4. Works well and made well. Made well for sure. Bought no name extension gas hose for 20 lb gas tank. The grill grates are awesome. All in working order and I am enjoying the baby Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new grill and like the electronic igniter but am disappointed in the covers, however.  No provision was made for those who use the propane canister.  The 7110 doesn’t cover it and the 7111 is much too wide and barely covers it.

Results.ReviewText: great size and efficiency for a 2-person household. Works very well and grilling temps are controlled and predictable. Ignition is very quick. Appears there is a nationwide shortage of the small propane tanks so we had to get the proper hose and fitting to connect a larger tank.

Results.ReviewText:
Okay first of all this is a good grill, easy to assemble, easy to clean and just really a well built grill.
I wish the instruction was very clear on this because it is clear from reviews on sites such as amazon that people were getting LOW flames...... 
I ran into low flames because I tripped the regulator by opening the switch on the grill then turn on the gas tank which should be the other way around.... combo that by the fact the switch looks like this off Max-------------------Min means that when I turn the switch all the way I was setting the flame to low setting lol..... 200 deg Ferenheit....
Took me a while to figure out I need to reset the regulator AND turn the knob NOT ALL THE WAY to get high flames.
I hope this review will help people because from reviews people were getting low flames and giving 1 stars on amazon
Results.Title: Good Grill but NOT intuitive

I've been looking for a small grill that I could use at home and camping. I saw the Q 1200 on Youtube. After doing my research I decided to order one. While ordered the orange, the color looks more of a gold. I love the grill. The weight is good and it's just the right size for my small back porch.
I'm still learning how to adjust the temp but I love it. I'm looking at ordering the griddle.

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill.... it cooks fast & you can taste that BBQ flavor just like using coals. Only thing is wish there’s a way to tell how much propane is in the tank.wish there’s one smaller that fits in a back pack
Results.Title: Beautiful Q1200

Results.ReviewText: I wanted as an extension of my kitchen. I don’t like cooking meat in the house. The grill heats up quickly. It gets very hot on the lowest heat setting so I set a pair of tongs half in half out to release a little heat. I deboned a whole chicken and roasted, I’ve also done some pounded and marinated beef cuts for teriyaki. Roasted vegetables. The cracks in the grate are small enough that I haven’t had anything slip through. So easy to start and quick to heat up!
Results.Title: I love my little grill!

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! Congratulations on your new Q1200 grill. It is unfortunate to hear of the food sticking to the grates. We suggest brushing a little olive oil on the food to help with this. We appreciate your feedback regarding the tank blocking the carry handle. We suggest removing the propane tank when transporting for safety reasons. If you need anything further please reach out to Weber's support team by phone at 800-446-1071 or by email at support@weberstephen.com. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: It cooks well but almost everything sticks and it has some design flaws. It's difficult to connect the tank because the handle above it is too close and it's impossible to get your hand around that same handle and grip it to carry because of the regulator positioning. Although it has some good points, I would not recommend this grill.
Results.Title: It's so so.

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Heats up fast and even. Enjoy extra tray tables on each side and thermostat. Had the smaller version for 10+ years and it was time for an up-grade. Worth every penny.
Results.Title: Compact and Powerful

Results.ReviewText: Incredibly versatile! So far I have grilled, baked potatoes, and looking forward to trying some additional baking items. I travel full time in a tiny camper without an oven so this little guy is a life saver. So glad I got it!
Results.Title: Very versatile!

Results.ReviewText: This grill works great. Only complaint is the regulator. It should come with a kit that doesn’t have a regulator for use with a camper. We’ve spent almost $100 making this grill useable with a camper propane tank.
Results.Title: Good Grill, but...

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love the grill. It’s perfect for me and my husband and yet still big enough when I have my son over and his family we can still grill out of enough food for everyone on it. I am a little disappointed that the regulator went out on it and it’s not even a-year-old yet and I have been waiting now for almost 2 weeks to get the part so that is a little frustrating but prior to that absolutely love the grill.
Results.Title: 1200 Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: It is an awesome little grill. I love the porcelain enameled cast iron.it leaves good grill marks evenly heated and easy to clean. Perfect to travel with especially for someone like me who overlands
